result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapters 4 and 5) covering bond procedures, the Disaster Council and emergency organization, and the start of the emergency price-gouging division, with no section text on algorithmic rent-setting despite the page URL.
result.notes: This part contains no rule in the six in-scope categories. The only housing-related text is the price-gouging definition of 'Housing' (§ 51.0203) and the emergency price-gouging purpose and authority sections, which concern excessive price increases during declared emergencies; the operative cap on rental increases is not included in this part, and it is not one of the six categories as a standalone rule here. The URL refers to Division 11 (anti-competitive automated rent price fixing, SDMC 98.1103), but that section's text does not appear in this part of the document, so no algorithmic_rent_setting record was created.
